method: 0.5 m grid over the piece boxes of each reach (+4 m). Footprint: points with a piece visual surface (engine_water_model.top_visual over all 99 pieces). Exposed edge: footprint boundary point whose outside 4-neighbour has terrain (tri_sample) more than 0.01 m below the piece surface and no sea (0.54 m) or remaining pond plane (cell_planes, sea cut 0.51, reach cells removed) above it. Outline: |sd| <= 0.25 m with bilinear sd of tests/terrain_v30/water_v30.npz; visible_outside_design: piece water above the terrain where sd > 1 m. R1 lies in the Narva zone, where sd is undefined.
